turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother. I'd like the zero withdrawn, and I'd like to know why nobody called me before it went in the gradebook. I have until 4:40.
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. That's one answer. Why did Owen find out from his phone, in the middle of class, and what exactly are you basing the zero on?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
Withdrawn is what I asked for, Hale. If the zero is withdrawn, why does Owen need a rewrite, and what are you basing that on? I'll want all of it in writing before I agree to anything.
Here it is in writing, signed.
I'm reading it. It had better say what you told me: zero withdrawn, private rewrite, nothing on his record. You still haven't told me what the rewrite is based on, Hale.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
We're not finished. You've told me what happens to Owen, and you still haven't told me why. Answer the question, Hale: what is the rewrite based on?

I'm not leaving, Hale. I've asked you twice what the rewrite is based on and you've given me nothing. If you won't answer, I'm going to the principal's office next, and I'll take your signed page with me.
